sources.entry: AerialSwap - Turn any video into a native Aerial wallpaper for the lock screen and desktop, in its own group in System Settings. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/mxpalm/AerialSwap) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: AerialSwap is a free, open-source macOS app that turns your own videos (or free Pixabay videos) into native Aerial wallpapers for the lock screen and desktop.
keywords: use my own video as wallpaper
summary.what_it_does: AerialSwap adds user-supplied videos to macOS's Aerial list so they appear in their own AerialSwap group in System Settings → Wallpaper. Videos can be dragged into the window, added from a URL, or picked from free videos in a built-in Discover browser that pulls from Pixabay. The app lets you trim a clip, name it, choose a Smooth motion option that adds in-between frames for a slow-down on unlock, and enable a seamless loop that blends the end into the start. An optional Enhance detail setting uses macOS AI upscaling for smaller videos. Finished wallpapers are kept in a library for switching later, and you can assign one to desktop only or screen saver only. According to the README, once set, playback is handled by macOS and AerialSwap does not need to keep running.
use_cases: use my own video as a lock screen wallpaper
turn a drone clip into a Mac wallpaper
find free 4K videos for desktop background
loop and trim a video for macOS wallpaper
keep a library of animated wallpapers on a Mac
add custom screensaver videos alongside Apple Aerials
how_to_run: Download AerialSwap-1.0.zip from the latest release and unzip it.
Move AerialSwap into the Applications folder.
Open the app; if macOS blocks it, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
If you have not used an Aerial yet, pick one once in System Settings → Wallpaper.
Add a video by dragging it into the window, using Add Video → From URL, or via Discover.
Click Set as Wallpaper and wait while the video is prepared in 4K.
notable: Adds custom videos as a separate AerialSwap group next to Apple's Aerials without altering Apple's videos
Seamless loop blending and Smooth in-between-frame slow-down on unlock
Built-in Discover browser for free Pixabay videos
Playback is handled by macOS, so no background process runs once a wallpaper is set
Wallpaper library lets you switch between saved videos and assign them to desktop or screen saver
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 27 according to the README
Uses parts of macOS that Apple does not officially offer to other apps, so major macOS updates may break it until a new version is released
Unsigned by Apple: first launch requires manually allowing the app in Privacy & Security settings
